name: Four Points by Sheraton Surabaya, Pakuwon Indah
short_description: Four Points by Sheraton Surabaya, Pakuwon Indah is a select-service hotel in West Surabaya connected directly to Pakuwon Mall, with a sixth-floor Lagoon Pool and the Djaman Doeloe Indonesian restaurant.
ai_summary: Four Points by Sheraton Surabaya, Pakuwon Indah is a select-service Marriott property that opened in 2019 in the upscale Pakuwon Indah area of West Surabaya. Its defining feature is a direct internal connection to Pakuwon Mall, one of Indonesia's largest shopping centres, which reviewers repeatedly cite as the main reason to book: guests can move between hotel and mall dining, cinema and retail without stepping outside. Independent reviewers and guest aggregates consistently praise the food, with the Djaman Doeloe Resto & Bar breakfast frequently called among the best in Surabaya, and the friendly, attentive service that punches above the brand's mid-tier positioning. Rooms are described as clean, modern and comfortable, and a sixth-floor Lagoon Pool plus gym round out the leisure facilities, making it popular for family staycations. Elite Bonvoy members report generous recognition, including suite upgrades and complimentary breakfast, and the hotel is regarded as strong value. Watch-outs are modest but real: the West Surabaya location sits roughly 30-35 minutes from the traditional city centre and downtown business districts, so it suits mall-focused or leisure stays more than central sightseeing. Some guests note evening noise from the lobby bar or nearby rooms, and one detailed blog review flagged an isolated housekeeping/privacy lapse. Overall it reads as a reliable, well-run, food-forward hotel best matched to travellers who value the mall link and pool over a central address.

faqs.question: How far is the hotel from Juanda International Airport?
faqs.answer: Four Points by Sheraton Surabaya, Pakuwon Indah sits in West Surabaya about 23 kilometres from Juanda International Airport (SUB). Depending on traffic the drive typically takes around 40 to 55 minutes, as the airport lies on the opposite, eastern side of the metropolitan area from the hotel.

faqs.question: Is the hotel really connected to Pakuwon Mall?
faqs.answer: Yes. The hotel links directly and internally to Pakuwon Mall, one of Indonesia's largest malls, so guests reach hundreds of shops, restaurants, a supermarket and a cinema without going outdoors. This mall connection is the feature reviewers cite most often as the reason to stay here.

faqs.question: What dining and facilities are available on site?
faqs.answer: The main outlet is Djaman Doeloe Resto & Bar, serving Indonesian dishes and the well-regarded breakfast buffet. Leisure facilities include a sixth-floor Lagoon Pool and a fitness centre, and the adjoining Pakuwon Mall adds an enormous range of additional dining and entertainment options.
